verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֹּ֖א אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽעִבְרִ֔ים שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bō ’el- par·‘ōh wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ê·lāw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rîm šal·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go to Pharaoh and tell him that this is what the LORD the God of the Hebrews says Let My people go so that they may worship Me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Entra a Faraó e dize-lhe: Assim diz Jeová, o Deus dos hebreus: Deixa ir o meu povo para que me sirva.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם־ מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לְשַׁלֵּ֑חַ וְעוֹדְךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֥יק בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- mā·’ên ’at·tāh lə·šal·lê·aḥ wə·‘ō·wḏ·ḵā ma·ḥă·zîq bām
verses.literal: But if you continue to restrain them and refuse to let them go
verses.literalPt: Pois, se tu recusares deixá-los ir e houveres de retê-los ainda,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יַד־ יְהוָ֜ה הוֹיָ֗ה בְּמִקְנְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּסּוּסִ֤ים בַּֽחֲמֹרִים֙ בַּגְּמַלִּ֔ים בַּבָּקָ֖ר וּבַצֹּ֑אן דֶּ֖בֶר כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yaḏ- Yah·weh hō·w·yāh bə·miq·nə·ḵā ’ă·šer baś·śā·ḏeh bas·sū·sîm ba·ḥă·mō·rîm bag·gə·mal·lîm bab·bā·qār ū·ḇaṣ·ṣōn de·ḇer kā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: then the hand of the LORD will bring a severe . . . plague on your livestock in the field on your horses donkeys camels herds and flocks
verses.literalPt: eis que a mão de Jeová é sobre o teu gado que está no campo, sobre os cavalos, sobre os jumentos, sobre os camelos, sobre os bois e sobre as ovelhas; haverá uma pestilência muito grave.

verses.original: וְהִפְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין מִקְנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבֵ֖ין מִקְנֵ֣ה מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת מִכָּל־ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hip̄·lāh Yah·weh bên miq·nêh yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇên miq·nêh miṣ·rā·yim wə·lō yā·mūṯ mik·kāl liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl dā·ḇār
verses.literal: But the LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel . . . and the livestock of Egypt so that no animal . . . belonging to the Israelites . . . will die
verses.literalPt: Jeová fará uma separação entre o gado de Israel e o gado do Egito; não morrerá nada de tudo o que pertence aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם יְהוָ֖ה מוֹעֵ֣ד לֵאמֹ֑ר מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem Yah·weh mō·w·‘êḏ lê·mōr mā·ḥār ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD set a time saying Tomorrow the LORD will do this . . . in the land
verses.literalPt: Jeová designou um prazo, dizendo: Amanhã, fará Jeová isso na terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיָּ֕מָת כֹּ֖ל מִקְנֵ֣ה מִצְרָ֑יִם וּמִמִּקְנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא־ מֵ֥ת אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yā·māṯ kōl miq·nêh miṣ·rā·yim ū·mim·miq·nêh ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lō- mêṯ ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: And the next day the LORD - did just that All the livestock of the Egyptians died but not one animal belonging to the Israelites . . . died
verses.literalPt: Fez Jeová isso no dia seguinte; morreu todo o gado do Egito, porém do gado dos filhos de Israel não morreu nenhum.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֗ה לֹא־ מֵ֛ת מִמִּקְנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ אֶחָ֑ד וַיִּכְבַּד֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ par·‘ōh wə·hin·nêh lō- mêṯ mim·miq·nêh yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- ’e·ḥāḏ way·yiḵ·baḏ lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·lō šil·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Pharaoh sent officials and found that none . . . of the livestock of the Israelites had died But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not let the people go
verses.literalPt: Mandou Faraó ver, e eis que do gado dos israelitas não morrera nem sequer um. Mas o coração de Faraó estava obstinado, e não deixou ir o povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מְלֹ֣א חָפְנֵיכֶ֔ם פִּ֖יחַ כִּבְשָׁ֑ן וּזְרָק֥וֹ מֹשֶׁ֛ה הַשָּׁמַ֖יְמָה לְעֵינֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn qə·ḥū lā·ḵem mə·lō ḥā·p̄ə·nê·ḵem pî·aḥ kiḇ·šān ū·zə·rā·qōw mō·šeh haš·šā·may·māh lə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron Take handfuls . . . of soot from the furnace in the sight of Pharaoh Moses is to toss it into the air
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão: Tomai-vos mãos cheias de cinza do forno e Moisés a lance ao ar diante de Faraó.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה לְאָבָ֔ק עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָיָ֨ה עַל־ הָאָדָ֜ם וְעַל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה לִשְׁחִ֥ין פֹּרֵ֛חַ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹ֖ת בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·’ā·ḇāq ‘al kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·hā·yāh ‘al- hā·’ā·ḏām wə·‘al- hab·bə·hê·māh liš·ḥîn pō·rê·aḥ ’ă·ḇa‘·bu·‘ōṯ bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: It will become fine dust over all the land of Egypt and festering boils will break out on man . . . and beast throughout the land . . .
verses.literalPt: E ela tornar-se-á em pó miúdo sobre toda a terra do Egito, e haverá tumores que se arrebentam em úlceras nos homens e no gado, por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ אֶת־ פִּ֣יחַ הַכִּבְשָׁ֗ן וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַיִּזְרֹ֥ק אֹת֛וֹ מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יְמָה וַיְהִ֗י שְׁחִין֙ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹ֔ת פֹּרֵ֕חַ בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- pî·aḥ hak·kiḇ·šān way·ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh way·yiz·rōq ’ō·ṯōw mō·šeh haš·šā·mā·yə·māh way·hî šə·ḥîn ’ă·ḇa‘·bu·‘ōṯ pō·rê·aḥ bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: So they took soot from the furnace and stood before Pharaoh Moses tossed it into the air and festering boils broke out on man and beast
verses.literalPt: Eles tomaram a cinza do forno e se apresentaram diante de Faraó; Moisés lançou-a ao ar, e ela tornou-se em tumores que se arrebentavam em úlceras nos homens e no gado.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יָכְל֣וּ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּ֗ים לַעֲמֹ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה מִפְּנֵ֣י הַשְּׁחִ֑ין כִּֽי־ הָיָ֣ה הַשְּׁחִ֔ין בַּֽחֲרְטֻמִּ֖ם וּבְכָל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū ha·ḥar·ṭum·mîm la·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê mō·šeh mip·pə·nê haš·šə·ḥîn kî- hā·yāh haš·šə·ḥîn ba·ḥăr·ṭum·mim ū·ḇə·ḵāl miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: The magicians could not stand before Moses because the boils - had broken out on them and on all the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: Os magos não podiam ter-se em pé diante de Moisés por causa dos tumores; pois havia tumores nos magos e em todos os egípcios.

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֤ק יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥaz·zêq Yah·weh ’eṯ- lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh
verses.literal: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart and he would not listen to them just as the LORD . . . had said to Moses
verses.literalPt: Jeová endureceu o coração de Faraó, e este não ouviu, como Jeová havia dito a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽעִבְרִ֔ים שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh haš·kêm bab·bō·qer wə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rîm šal·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Get up early in the morning stand before Pharaoh and tell him that this is what the LORD the God of the Hebrews says Let My people go so that they may worship Me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Levanta-te de manhã cedo, apresenta-te diante de Faraó e dize-lhe: Assim diz Jeová, o Deus dos hebreus: Deixa ir o meu povo para que me sirva.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֗את אֲנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ אֶת־ כָּל־ מַגֵּפֹתַי֙ אֶֽל־ לִבְּךָ֔ וּבַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וּבְעַמֶּ֑ךָ בַּעֲב֣וּר תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין כָּמֹ֖נִי בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî bap·pa·‘am haz·zōṯ ’ă·nî šō·lê·aḥ ’eṯ- kāl- mag·gê·p̄ō·ṯay ’el- lib·bə·ḵā ū·ḇa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·ḇə·‘am·me·ḵā ba·‘ă·ḇūr tê·ḏa‘ kî ’ên kā·mō·nî bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Otherwise . . . . . . I will send all My plagues against you and your officials and your people so you may know that there is no one like Me in all the earth
verses.literalPt: Pois esta vez enviarei todas as minhas pragas sobre o teu coração, e sobre os teus servos, e sobre o teu povo; para que saibas que não há quem seja semelhante a mim em toda a terra.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֶת־ יָדִ֔י וָאַ֥ךְ אוֹתְךָ֛ וְאֶֽת־ עַמְּךָ֖ בַּדָּ֑בֶר וַתִּכָּחֵ֖ד מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘at·tāh šā·laḥ·tî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî wā·’aḵ ’ō·wṯ·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā bad·dā·ḇer wat·tik·kā·ḥêḏ min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For by this time I could have stretched out My hand and struck you and your people with a plague to wipe you off the earth
verses.literalPt: Agora, eu poderia ter estendido a mão e ferido a ti e ao teu povo com pestilência, e tu terias sido cortado da terra;

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֗ם בַּעֲב֥וּר זֹאת֙ הֶעֱמַדְתִּ֔יךָ בַּעֲב֖וּר הַרְאֹתְךָ֣ אֶת־ כֹּחִ֑י וּלְמַ֛עַן סַפֵּ֥ר שְׁמִ֖י בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām ba·‘ă·ḇūr zōṯ he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tî·ḵā ba·‘ă·ḇūr har·’ō·ṯə·ḵā ’eṯ- kō·ḥî ū·lə·ma·‘an sap·pêr šə·mî bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But I have raised you up for this very purpose . . . that I might display My power to you and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth
verses.literalPt: mas deveras para isso te hei mantido em pé, para te mostrar o meu poder e para que o meu nome seja anunciado em toda a terra.

verses.original: עוֹדְךָ֖ מִסְתּוֹלֵ֣ל בְּעַמִּ֑י לְבִלְתִּ֖י שַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ·ḵā mis·tō·w·lêl bə·‘am·mî lə·ḇil·tî šal·lə·ḥām
verses.literal: Still you lord it over My people and do not allow them to go
verses.literalPt: Levantas-te ainda contra o meu povo, para não deixá-lo ir?

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י מַמְטִיר֙ כָּעֵ֣ת מָחָ֔ר בָּרָ֖ד כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ הָיָ֤ה כָמֹ֙הוּ֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם לְמִן־ הַיּ֥וֹם הִוָּסְדָ֖ה וְעַד־ עָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mam·ṭîr kā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār bā·rāḏ kā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer lō- hā·yāh ḵā·mō·hū bə·miṣ·ra·yim lə·min- hay·yō·wm hiw·wā·sə·ḏāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘āt·tāh
verses.literal: Behold at this time tomorrow I will rain down the worst . . . hail that has ever fallen . . . on Egypt from the day it was founded until now
verses.literalPt: Eis que amanhã por este tempo farei cair uma mui grande chuva de pedras, como nunca houve no Egito desde o dia em que foi fundado até agora.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שְׁלַ֤ח הָעֵז֙ אֶֽת־ מִקְנְךָ֔ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְךָ֖ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה כָּל־ הָאָדָ֨ם וְהַבְּהֵמָ֜ה אֲשֶֽׁר־ יִמָּצֵ֣א בַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יֵֽאָסֵף֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וְיָרַ֧ד עֲלֵהֶ֛ם הַבָּרָ֖ד וָמֵֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·laḥ hā·‘êz ’eṯ- miq·nə·ḵā wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer lə·ḵā baś·śā·ḏeh kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām wə·hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer- yim·mā·ṣê ḇaś·śā·ḏeh wə·lō yê·’ā·sêp̄ hab·bay·ṯāh wə·yā·raḏ ‘ă·lê·hem hab·bā·rāḏ wā·mê·ṯū
verses.literal: So give orders now to shelter your livestock and everything you have in the field Every man or beast that remains in the field and is not brought inside will die when the hail comes down upon them
verses.literalPt: Envia, recolhe com pressa o teu gado e tudo o que tens no campo; pois sobre todo homem e animal que se acharem no campo e não se recolherem à casa cairá a chuva de pedras, e morrerão.

verses.original: הַיָּרֵא֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מֵֽעַבְדֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֑ה הֵנִ֛יס אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֥יו וְאֶת־ מִקְנֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַבָּתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yā·rê ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh mê·‘aḇ·ḏê par·‘ōh hê·nîs ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·’eṯ- miq·nê·hū ’el- hab·bāt·tîm
verses.literal: Those among Pharaoh’s officials who feared the word of the LORD hurried to bring their servants and livestock to shelter
verses.literalPt: Aquele que dentre os servos de Faraó temia a Jeová fez fugir os seus servos e o seu gado para as casas;

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ שָׂ֛ם לִבּ֖וֹ אֶל־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֥יו וְאֶת־ מִקְנֵ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer lō- śām lib·bōw ’el- də·ḇar Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·’eṯ- miq·nê·hū baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: but those who disregarded the word . . . of the LORD . . . left their servants and livestock in the field
verses.literalPt: porém aquele que não se importava com a palavra de Jeová deixou os seus servos e o seu gado no campo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה נְטֵ֤ה אֶת־ יָֽדְךָ֙ עַל־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וִיהִ֥י בָרָ֖ד בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ הָאָדָ֣ם וְעַל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְעַ֛ל כָּל־ עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh nə·ṭêh ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- haš·šā·ma·yim wî·hî ḇā·rāḏ bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ‘al- hā·’ā·ḏām wə·‘al- hab·bə·hê·māh wə·‘al kāl- ‘ê·śeḇ haś·śā·ḏeh bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Stretch out your hand toward heaven so that hail may fall on all the land of Egypt on man . . . and beast . . . and every plant of the field throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Estende a tua mão para o céu, a fim de que caia uma chuva de pedras em toda a terra do Egito, sobre homens, sobre animais e sobre toda a erva do campo em toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת־ מַטֵּהוּ֮ עַל־ הַשָּׁמַיִם֒ וַֽיהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קֹלֹת֙ וּבָרָ֔ד וַתִּ֥הֲלַךְ אֵ֖שׁ אָ֑רְצָה וַיַּמְטֵ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בָּרָ֖ד עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ mō·šeh ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭê·hū ‘al- haš·šā·ma·yim Yah·weh nā·ṯan qō·lōṯ ū·ḇā·rāḏ wat·ti·hă·laḵ ’êš ’ā·rə·ṣāh way·yam·ṭêr Yah·weh bā·rāḏ ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So Moses stretched out his staff toward heaven and the LORD sent thunder and hail and lightning struck the earth So the LORD rained down hail upon the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Moisés estendeu a sua vara para o céu; Jeová enviou trovões e chuva de pedras, e fogo desceu à terra; e fez Jeová cair uma chuva de pedras sobre a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בָרָ֔ד וְאֵ֕שׁ מִתְלַקַּ֖חַת בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבָּרָ֑ד כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ הָיָ֤ה כָמֹ֙הוּ֙ בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵאָ֖ז הָיְתָ֥ה לְגֽוֹי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇā·rāḏ wə·’êš miṯ·laq·qa·ḥaṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ hab·bā·rāḏ kā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer lō- hā·yāh ḵā·mō·hū bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mê·’āz hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḡō·w
verses.literal: The hail fell and the lightning continued flashing through it The hail was so severe that nothing like it had ever been seen in all the land of Egypt from the time it became a nation
verses.literalPt: Assim havia chuva de pedras e fogo misturado com a chuva de pedras mui grande, qual nunca houve em toda a terra do Egito desde que veio a ser uma nação.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨ךְ הַבָּרָ֜ד בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ עֵ֤שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה֙ הִכָּ֣ה הַבָּרָ֔ד וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה שִׁבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ hab·bā·rāḏ bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer baś·śā·ḏeh mê·’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ê·śeḇ haś·śā·ḏeh hik·kāh hab·bā·rāḏ wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘êṣ haś·śā·ḏeh šib·bêr
verses.literal: Throughout the land of Egypt the hail struck down everything in the field both man and beast it beat down every plant of the field and stripped every tree . . .
verses.literalPt: Por toda a terra do Egito, a chuva de pedras feriu tudo quanto havia no campo, tanto homens como animais; a chuva de pedras feriu toda a erva do campo e quebrou toda árvore do campo.

verses.original: רַ֚ק בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֥א הָיָ֖ה בָּרָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: raq bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen ’ă·šer- šām bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lō hā·yāh bā·rāḏ
verses.literal: The only place where it did not hail was in the land of Goshen where the Israelites . . . lived
verses.literalPt: Somente na terra de Gósen, onde se achavam os filhos de Israel, não havia chuva de pedras.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח פַּרְעֹ֗ה וַיִּקְרָא֙ לְמֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֖ם חָטָ֣אתִי הַפָּ֑עַם יְהוָה֙ הַצַּדִּ֔יק וַאֲנִ֥י וְעַמִּ֖י הָרְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ par·‘ōh way·yiq·rā lə·mō·šeh ū·lə·’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ḥā·ṭā·ṯî hap·pā·‘am Yah·weh haṣ·ṣad·dîq wa·’ă·nî wə·‘am·mî hā·rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh summoned . . . Moses and Aaron This time I have sinned he said . . . The LORD is righteous and I and my people are wicked
verses.literalPt: Mandou Faraó chamar a Moisés e a Arão e disse-lhes: Esta vez pequei; Jeová é justo, e eu e o meu povo somos ímpios.

verses.original: הַעְתִּ֙ירוּ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְרַ֕ב מִֽהְיֹ֛ת קֹלֹ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּבָרָ֑ד וַאֲשַׁלְּחָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תֹסִפ֖וּן לַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ha‘·tî·rū ’el- Yah·weh wə·raḇ mih·yōṯ qō·lōṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇā·rāḏ wa·’ă·šal·lə·ḥāh ’eṯ·ḵem wə·lō ṯō·si·p̄ūn la·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: Pray to the LORD for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail I will let you go you do not need to stay any longer
verses.literalPt: Rogai a Jeová, pois já bastam estes grandes trovões e a chuva de pedras. Eu vos deixarei ir, e vós não permanecereis mais aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּצֵאתִי֙ אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר אֶפְרֹ֥שׂ אֶת־ כַּפַּ֖י אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה הַקֹּל֣וֹת יֶחְדָּל֗וּן וְהַבָּרָד֙ לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ ע֔וֹד לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֥י לַיהוָ֖ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw mō·šeh kə·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·‘îr ’ep̄·rōś ’eṯ- kap·pay ’el- Yah·weh haq·qō·lō·wṯ yeḥ·dā·lūn wə·hab·bā·rāḏ lō yih·yeh- ‘ō·wḏ lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏa‘ kî Yah·weh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Moses said to him When I have left the city I will spread out my hands to the LORD The thunder will cease and there will be no more hail so that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Moisés: Logo que eu tiver saído da cidade, estenderei as mãos a Jeová; cessarão os trovões, e não haverá mais chuva de pedras, para que saibas que a terra é de Jeová.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה וַעֲבָדֶ֑יךָ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּ֚י טֶ֣רֶם תִּֽירְא֔וּן מִפְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā yā·ḏa‘·tî kî ṭe·rem tî·rə·’ūn mip·pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: But as for you and your officials I know that you still do not fear . . . the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto a ti e a teus servos, eu sei que ainda não temereis a Deus Jeová.

verses.original: וְהַפִּשְׁתָּ֥ה וְהַשְּׂעֹרָ֖ה נֻכָּ֑תָה כִּ֤י הַשְּׂעֹרָה֙ אָבִ֔יב וְהַפִּשְׁתָּ֖ה גִּבְעֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hap·piš·tāh wə·haś·śə·‘ō·rāh nuk·kā·ṯāh kî haś·śə·‘ō·rāh ’ā·ḇîḇ wə·hap·piš·tāh giḇ·‘ōl
verses.literal: Now the flax and barley were destroyed since the barley . . . was ripe and the flax was in bloom
verses.literalPt: O linho e a cevada foram feridos, pois a cevada estava na espiga, e o linho, em flor.

verses.original: וְהַחִטָּ֥ה וְהַכֻּסֶּ֖מֶת לֹ֣א נֻכּ֑וּ כִּ֥י אֲפִילֹ֖ת הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥiṭ·ṭāh wə·hak·kus·se·meṯ lō nuk·kū kî ’ă·p̄î·lōṯ hên·nāh
verses.literal: but the wheat and spelt were not destroyed because they are late crops
verses.literalPt: Mas o trigo e a espelta não receberam dano, pois não estavam crescidos.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵעִ֤ם פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר וַיִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיַּחְדְּל֤וּ הַקֹּלוֹת֙ וְהַבָּרָ֔ד וּמָטָ֖ר לֹא־ נִתַּ֥ךְ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê mō·šeh mê·‘im par·‘ōh ’eṯ- hā·‘îr way·yip̄·rōś kap·pāw ’el- Yah·weh way·yaḥ·də·lū haq·qō·lō·wṯ wə·hab·bā·rāḏ ū·mā·ṭār lō- nit·taḵ ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: Then Moses departed from Pharaoh went out of the city and spread out his hands to the LORD The thunder and hail ceased and the rain no longer poured down on the land
verses.literalPt: Saiu Moisés da cidade, da presença de Faraó, e estendeu as mãos a Jeová; cessaram os trovões e a chuva de pedras, e não caiu mais saraiva sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא פַּרְעֹ֗ה כִּֽי־ חָדַ֨ל הַמָּטָ֧ר וְהַבָּרָ֛ד וְהַקֹּלֹ֖ת וַיֹּ֣סֶף לַחֲטֹ֑א וַיַּכְבֵּ֥ד לִבּ֖וֹ ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar par·‘ōh kî- ḥā·ḏal ham·mā·ṭār wə·hab·bā·rāḏ wə·haq·qō·lōṯ way·yō·sep̄ la·ḥă·ṭō way·yaḵ·bêḏ lib·bōw hū wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had ceased he sinned again and hardened his heart he and his officials
verses.literalPt: Tendo Faraó visto que a chuva, e a saraiva, e os trovões haviam cessado, tornou a pecar e endureceu o seu coração, ele e os seus servos.

verses.original: וַֽיֶּחֱזַק֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·lō šil·laḥ ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not let the Israelites . . . go just as the LORD had said through Moses
verses.literalPt: O coração de Faraó ficou endurecido, e não deixou ir os filhos de Israel; como Jeová havia dito a Moisés.
